properties.label: Centred physical action slot
properties.text: Compose a sparse dark page with centred type and one physical-looking action slot, using a thin amber line beneath it as the only luminous event.

properties.label: Silver and amber on black
properties.text: Use near-black #08080a, soft silver type and amber #ffb43c.

properties.label: Recessed emissive slot
properties.text: Keep the dark recessed surround and physical rim visible around the thin source line.

properties.label: Local amber source and halo
properties.text: Build a small bright source and a wider low-opacity halo while preserving the line's sharp core; body-copy contrast must remain independent of the glow.

properties.label: Local light feedback
properties.text: Use local light and label feedback for press and copy actions.

properties.label: Single-line signal sweep
properties.text: If a signal sweeps, keep its bright head and softer tail on the same line and stop it at rest.

properties.label: Bloom and edge acceptance
properties.text: Ensure bloom never washes out the action label, then inspect edge sharpness close up, silhouette at a distance and contrast on desktop and phone.
